messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: ded-vpc-high-error-rate - priority P1 - triggered by 5xx spike in Apollo Systems dedicated pool (pool-id: pool-AP-3)

alice_kim: I’m on it. Paging SRE oncall. Can someone grab customer contact and current canary percentage?

sre-oncall: Oncall here. I see elevated 5xx across a subset of nodes. Canary rollout for v2.7.4 was at 15% for Apollo earlier today. Linking graph: https://infra.internal/graphs/pool-AP-3/errors

mike_ramos: Noted. Apollo reports higher latency and occasional hallucinations in chat sessions per Apollo Support. They say it started ~12:12 UTC.

eng-runtime: Seeing OOM-ish tail logs on a handful of dedicated workers, but primarily RPC timeouts to a quantized kernel conversion step.

carol_chan: Can we quickly isolate the canary cohort? If it's pinned artifact related we should revert the canary traffic to the previous pinned artifact.

eng-platform: Deploy bot: `deploy-bot` posted: canary rollout v2.7.4 -> pool-AP-3 at 2026-03-15T12:00Z. Artifact: `redwood-infer:2.7.4-q8`.

solutions-eng: Apollo-support confirmed they're on v2.7.4. They asked for an ETA and whether we can do a quick pinback.

apollo-support: Apollo ops: Impact: roughly 20% of requests return 5xx (model runtime errors) and ~10% of sessions have degraded responses. Customer is starting throttling on their side to reduce user-visible errors. They want a rollback.

sre-oncall: OK. Runbook step 3: isolate tenant + pinback. I’ll coordinate. @eng-platform can you perform a pinned artifact revert for the dedicated pool? If we need to scale down canary nodes we should do that first to avoid further bad traffic.

eng-platform: Initiating pinback. Running command: ```
# pin pool to artifact
redwoodctl pool pin --pool pool-AP-3 --artifact redwood-infer:2.7.3 --reason "emergency revert due to 5xx spike"
```

ops-bot: Action logged: pool-AP-3 pinned to redwood-infer:2.7.3 by eng-platform (req-id: a1b2c3). Telemetry retention extended for 2h.

eng-runtime: Rolling canary nodes back now. Draining 3 canary allocs and reassigning traffic. Watch pods: `kubectl -n redwood get pods -l pool=pool-AP-3`

mike_ramos: I’m dropping the canary weight in the routing plane from 15% -> 0% in steps: 15 -> 5 -> 0. Doing first step now.

carol_chan: Confirming: after weight 0 we'll confirm metrics for 10m and then unpin if stable? Or leave pinned until postmortem?

sre-oncall: Leave pin for now until we confirm stability and root cause. Postmortem will decide permanent state. Priorities: (1) stop 5xx, (2) restore customer SLA, (3) capture CI artifacts/logs for RCA.

incident-bot: update: canary weight set to 5% by mike_ramos at 12:18 UTC.

eng-platform: canary weight set to 0% at 12:21 UTC. All new requests should hit redwood-infer:2.7.3.

apollo-support: Confirmed from Apollo: errors dropped to ~1.5% within 3 minutes of rollback. They are rolling back local throttles and verifying sessions. Thank you.

alice_kim: Good. SRE, can you collect flamegraphs and the `stderr`/`stdout` for the failing allocs? Need to attach to incident for postmortem. Runbook: `https://runbooks.redwood/incidents/dedicated-canary`

eng-runtime: Grabbing logs and kernel traces now. Running: ```
redwoodctl logs --pool pool-AP-3 --since 30m --filter "error OR OOM" > /tmp/pool-AP-3-errors.log
redwoodctl trace collect --pool pool-AP-3 --allocs failing --out /tmp/pool-AP-3-trace.tar.gz
```

ops-bot: Logs archived: s3://incidents/pool-AP-3/2112345678/errors.log (expires in 7d). Trace bundle uploaded (scan in progress).

sre-oncall: Customer impact classification: P1 (degraded UX, not a data loss event). Pager cleared once rollback confirmed. I’ll hand off to morning SRE shift for RCA. Handoff notes: rollback performed, artifacts archived, leave pin in place, collect perf diffs between 2.7.3 and 2.7.4 quantization path.

carol_chan: Thanks. I'll open a dedicated RCA ticket and tag eng-runtime + eng-ml for kernel/quantization analysis. Also will schedule a sync with Apollo for 15:00 UTC to review impact and next steps.

apollo-support: Apollo ops: Thanks team. We appreciate the fast revert. We'll attend the 15:00 sync and can provide sample session ids.

mike_ramos: Final note: I saw a single node that failed to drain cleanly and had to be cordoned and restarted. Marking for follow-up.

incident-bot: Incident closed (manual) by sre-oncall at 12:42 UTC. Follow-up: RCA ticket created INC-2112345678-RCA.

sre-oncall: Leaving detailed timeline in the ticket and will handoff to daylight SRE. If anyone finds additional anomalies in the trace bundle DM me.

alice_kim: Thanks all. Good job executing the pinned-artifact rollback under pressure. :thumbsup:
